brief: The next six weeks are about processes that slip rather than conclude. The PABS annex talks in Geneva are very unlikely to produce a December special Assembly, since the decision point was 10 November and the text still has open issues. COP31 should run over and end with a modest outcome. The Special European Council on 26-27 November will not close the 2028-34 budget. The calendar entry for the Palestinian election on 28 November looks stale: Wikipedia reports it was postponed on 10 October to September 2027, so I put it at about 3%. Spain's 29 November vote favours the PP, and a PP-Vox majority is the likelier result, which matters for EU health files. I agree with the crowd on the Iran ceasefire (94%) and on pandemic-type markets sitting at 1-2%. I part ways with the long-dated Manifold markets on a Ukrainian 'win' (30%) and on Ukraine holding Crimea (27%), which I think are far too high.

events.title: IGWG9 — PABS annex negotiations (WHO Pandemic Agreement)
events.expect: No final PABS annex this round. Gaps remain on scope, access modalities and governance. The 10 November cut-off for a December special WHA session is effectively missed. Expect a progress report and handover toward WHA80 in May 2027, possibly with extra reserved sessions.

events.title: COP31 — UN Climate Change Conference
events.expect: An 'intermediate' COP with no big-ticket mandate, no official US delegation and the EU ruling out new finance pledges. Expect a modest cover decision built around electrification and adaptation, agreed after an overrun. A fossil-fuel transition roadmap in the formal text is unlikely.

COP31's closing plenary runs past the scheduled end on 20 November 2026
The adopted COP31 cover decision contains an agreed roadmap for transitioning away from fossil fuels

events.expect: Heavy on speeches. Von der Leyen, Lula and Sisi are among those reported as expected, and MBS is also reported as expected. Washington stays away officially, with only a congressional and sub-national delegation. Pledges will be voluntary and non-binding.

The US federal government sends no official delegation to COP31 through 12 November 2026

events.title: European Political Community — 9th meeting
events.expect: Dublin hosts the EPC on 12 November, followed by an informal EU leaders' meeting on 13 November. Expect Ukraine, Russia and security to dominate, with Zelensky present. There will be no binding decisions. A Russia-Ukraine ceasefire is not on the cards (crowd 4% by 30 November, which I accept).

calls.q: Volodymyr Zelensky attends the Dublin EPC meeting in person on 12 November 2026

events.watch: Reports of a Trump-Putin meeting date or a sudden shift in ceasefire talks.

events.title: APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting
events.expect: China hosts in Shenzhen. APEC usually manages a leaders' declaration even in tense years, with trade and supply-chain language. I have no confirmed information on US leader attendance, so that call is a low-confidence estimate.

calls.q: APEC leaders adopt a joint leaders' declaration at Shenzhen by 20 November 2026
Donald Trump attends the Shenzhen APEC Leaders' Meeting in person

events.watch: Official US delegation announcement; disputes over trade or Hormuz wording.

events.expect: WHO's own schedule puts the first forum on 18-19 November, a day earlier than your calendar. Seven nominees were announced on 29 October, including Kluge, Balkhy and Al-Kuwari. Expect a webcast with interviews and no elimination. The Executive Board shortlist comes in January.

events.expect: The committee debate precedes EPSCO Health on 8 December and will be used to fix the Dutch line for it. Postponements of committee debates are common, so I keep some slippage risk. I have not searched the agenda and cannot say what it covers.

events.title: Special European Council on the MFF 2028–2034
events.expect: The 2028-34 budget needs unanimity, and net-payer and cohesion/farm camps are far apart. Leaders will run a negotiating round and set a path for more talks, not a deal. Health spending lines stay open.

calls.q: EU leaders reach political agreement on the 2028-2034 MFF by 28 November 2026

events.title: Taiwan — local elections (nine-in-one)
events.expect: The KMT should again win more of the 22 mayor and county chief posts than the DPP, as in 2022 (my recollection is 14 of 22). A local result has no direct effect on cross-strait military risk, so I stay near 1% on invasion. I did not search this race.

events.title: Spain — snap general election
events.expect: Sánchez called the vote after his housing decrees failed on 2 October. PolitPro's trend has the PP on 29.8% and the PSOE on 26.9%, with Vox at 18.7%. The PSOE-Sumar bloc is short of a majority. A PP-Vox seat majority is more likely than not.

calls.q: The PP wins the most seats in Spain's 29 November 2026 election
PP and Vox together win at least 176 of 350 Congress seats

events.watch: Final polls before the poll ban; Junts and Catalan seat counts.

events.title: The Gambia — presidential election
events.expect: Incumbent Adama Barrow is the favourite against a fragmented opposition, as when he won 2021 with roughly 53% (my recollection). The Gambia has a single round and no runoff. Opposition rejection of results is possible. I have not searched this race.
